notes: Email Studio ships a MailTracker-backed sent email resource, template library, variant editor, theme editor, and extension settings surface. Capture these through the Capell screenshot runner after the runner app has MailTracker rows, template registrations, theme rows, variants, and Email Studio settings seeded.

entries.title: Sent emails admin index.
entries.notes: Capture after seeding MailTracker sent email rows with subjects, sender/recipient addresses, opens, clicks, and stored content state.
entries.useCase: A support user reviews sent transactional emails and delivery engagement signals in the Capell admin.

entries.title: Sent email detail view.
entries.notes: Capture after seeding a MailTracker sent email record with headers, stored HTML content, and at least one tracked URL click row.
entries.useCase: A support user opens an immutable sent email snapshot to inspect metadata, headers, tracked URLs, and stored HTML output.

entries.title: Registered email templates index.
entries.notes: Capture after registering static templates from Email Studio and Comments so package, status, and variable columns are populated.
entries.useCase: An admin reviews package-provided templates and starts customization from a static default.

entries.title: Email template themes.
entries.notes: Capture after seeding the default theme and at least one site-scoped branded theme.
entries.useCase: An admin edits the branding tokens used by themed transactional email templates.
